name: Marc-Andre Beaudry
headline: Principal Software Developer at Upgrade Inc.
about: Principal Software Developer at Upgrade, Inc., building and scaling backend systems for consumer financial products including Upgrade OneCard, Boost Cash, and Boost Money. Over 10 years of experience designing high-performance Java services and leading engineering initiatives across fintech and enterprise platforms. Passionate about clean architecture, developer mentorship, and building reliable systems that empower customers.

education.notes: GPA 4.19 / 4.30. Received Joseph-Armand Bombardier Scholarship (2013) and Medal of Merit (2014) for academic excellence and professionalism.

experience.title: Principal Software Developer
experience.summary: Leading backend development for Upgrade’s financial products, including Upgrade OneCard, Boost Cash, and Boost Money. Designing and maintaining scalable Java Spring Boot microservices powering customer accounts, credit transactions, and rewards systems. Collaborating closely with product and mobile teams to deliver secure, reliable APIs and integrations. Driving architecture improvements, code quality standards, and deployment automation across multiple backend services.

experience.title: Vice President – Engineering Manager, Enterprise System Management
experience.summary: Managed a team of 12 full stack developers in Montreal and 5 in Bangalore across a dozen+ systems. Chapter lead for a 40+ engineer org; authored 50+ guideline articles and coached developers in Spring Boot & Angular best practices. Mentored 25+ developers and supervised agile squads delivering asset inventory, network lifecycle management, and firmwide monitoring systems. Led a 2-year migration of two large Flash-based applications (>1M LOC) to Angular Material.

experience.title: Engineering Manager, Enterprise System Management
experience.summary: Built and led a 10-developer full stack team; set coding standards for Spring Boot + Angular. Delivered infrastructure components, including: a graph data platform (~1B triples) for analytics; an Elasticsearch typeahead search over 50M documents; and data marketplace APIs used by hundreds of internal systems for monitoring, regulatory reporting, billing, and incident management. Built Angular Material apps used daily by 20k+ users; engineered network access control with Cisco ISE for >1M devices.

experience.title: Software Developer – Billing and Payment Instruments
experience.summary: Delivered a new payment gateway integration in Spring Boot; designed payment strategies for complex telco billing; built an Angular + Spring Boot test automation system for gateway integrations.

experience.title: Software Developer – Enterprise Infrastructure
experience.summary: Built trading infringement visualization tools (KDB, DB2, Java Spring, C# WPF). Implemented configuration management graph analytics on MarkLogic (RDF). Designed microservices and API gateway with Spring + Zookeeper; blue-green deployments; D3.js data exploration widgets.

experience.title: Software Developer – Intern, Software Engineering
experience.summary: Designed a C# WPF software/hardware system for electric motor characterization, cutting the process from two weeks to a few hours; integrated three measurement devices via native C++ libraries.

experience.title: Software Developer – Intern, Automation Department
experience.summary: Created a Java app for versioning electrical/mechanical drawings, reducing documentation time by ~80% and improving permissioning and visibility.
